message.content:
I am breath made visible, thought crossing the air, silence shaped into meaning. I begin before words, in the lift of the chest, the spark behind the tongue, the urge to reach another mind. I am murmur, command, confession, laughter, oath, prayer, stammer, song.

I bind strangers, soothe infants, start wars, end loneliness, betray secrets, teach names to the nameless. I can be velvet or blade. I can tremble. I can thunder. In me, feeling finds form.

Before ink, I traveled. Before screens, I lived in mouths and memory. I vanish the instant I arrive, yet I linger in hearts, in echoes, in consequence.

Listen: I am not only what is said, but how. Pace, pause, pitch, emphasis—the rise that invites, the break that reveals, the hush that means more than sound. Even silence leans against me; without it, I have no shape.

I am the bridge from inner world to outer world. I am speech.
